title: **A manifestation of Islamic unity in India:** Iran's Judiciary Chief, Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Eje'i, prayed behind the Sunni imam during the Friday congregational prayers in Delhi.
text:
**A manifestation of Islamic unity in India:** Iran's Judiciary Chief, Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Eje'i, prayed behind the Sunni imam during the Friday congregational prayers in Delhi."

"Note: This gesture is particularly significant as Iran is predominantly Shia, while the vast majority of India's Muslim community is Sunni. The head of Iran's judiciary openly following a Sunni prayer leader in a foreign country serves as a strong symbolic act of cross-sectarian solidarity.
